after.zh: 三张照片按固定的系数相减，得到反射率乘上法线的三个分量 ρ·(nx, ny, nz)。法线长度是 1，所以这个向量的长度就是反射率 ρ，方向就是法线。三盏灯，三个方程，三个未知数（加上 ρ 一共四个数，靠「长度为 1」补上最后一个）。
after.en: Subtracting the three photos with fixed weights gives the reflectance times each component of the normal: ρ·(nx, ny, nz). A normal has length 1, so the length of this vector is the reflectance ρ and its direction is the normal. Three lamps, three equations, three unknowns (with ρ there are four numbers, and "length 1" supplies the last one).

t.zh: <level-ref to="3-10"></level-ref>只问了朝右还是朝左。三盏灯其实能告诉你更多：每一点的漆色和朝向，都能解出来。
t.en: <level-ref to="3-10"></level-ref> only asked left or right. Three lamps can tell you more: the paint and the facing at every point can both be solved.

t.zh: 这一关你要做的：同样的三张照片，输出漆色本身，也就是每一点的反射率，和表面朝哪边无关。
t.en: Your task in this level: from the same three photos, output the paint itself, the reflectance at every point, whichever way the surface faces.

caption.zh: 第一组测试：鼓包上的漆
caption.en: Set 1: the paint on a bump

brief.zh: 同样的三张照片。这次输出漆色本身：每一点的反射率，和表面朝哪边无关。
brief.en: The same three photos. This time output the paint itself: the reflectance at every point, whichever way the surface faces.

hint.zh: 正面灯的照片是反射率 × nz。另两张各多了一个分量。
hint.en: The front lamp's photo is reflectance × nz. The other two each bring in one more component.
